implementation.note: Clip-space indexed triangles, per-pixel depth, textures and framebuffer readback exercised through the Device API.

architecture.note: Process-owned gfx::Device implements the common render interface. Model capture shares the model loader and thumbnail path across devices.

native_api.note: Device creation, indexed geometry, sampled textures, capture and resource updates exercised through the public C++ interface.

skill.note: The modeling skill documents the capture command and backend selection.

mcp.note: Device selection belongs to the native capture process. There is no authored operation or scene property to expose over MCP.

studio.note: The backend is selected by the host when it creates a device. This feature introduces no editable Studio data.

inspector.note: The opaque device belongs to the process, with no inspector-facing entity or component.

persistence.note: GPU and raster resources have process lifetime. Capture produces PNG via the existing exporter and adds no persisted scene fields.

graphs.note: Backend selection happens before any draw. It creates no graph nodes or graph assets.

performance.note: Measured startup, model decoding, 512-square rasterization and PNG encoding in one CPU capture.

platforms.note: Native macOS arm64 tests and model capture.

dependencies.note: The CPU rasterizer uses the existing model and PNG code and the C++ standard library.

headless.note: CPU geometry capture rendered arch.obj and produced 70800 non-background pixels.

examples.note: The documentation gives the native model capture command. The test exercises its rendering contract.

tests.note: Native Mac CTest covering device rasterization and textured model PNG.

handoff.note: Stage SHA, runner, test outcomes and remaining scope.

documentation.note: Render API, capture invocation, supported formats and scope are documented.

publishing.note: The native thumbnail is recorded. Public release-site validation is pending.
